tuong_duong_jx1: KNpc co m_CurrentCamp (KNpc.h:279) + KNpc::SetCurrentCamp (KNpc.cpp:442, tu dong bo) ; Lua SetCurCamp (ScriptFuns.cpp:7847 LuaSetPlayerCurrentCamp), GetCamp. citywar_arena/head.lua:91 SetCurCamp(Camp) + :54 SetCurCamp(camp goc) la dung cach nay. camp 1 = camp_justice, 2 = camp_evil (GameDataDef.h:487-488) - hai phe khac nhau + FightMode = danh nhau duoc.
cach_viet:
int LuaSetTmpCamp(Lua_State* L){ int nTop=Lua_GetTopIndex(L); if(nTop<1){Lua_PushNumber(L,0);return 1;} int nCamp=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1); if(nCamp<0||nCamp>=camp_num){Lua_PushNumber(L,0);return 1;} int nNpc=0; if(nTop>=2){ nNpc=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,2); if(nNpc<=0||nNpc>=MAX_NPC){Lua_PushNumber(L,0);return 1;} } else { int nP=GetPlayerIndex(L); if(nP<=0){Lua_PushNumber(L,0);return 1;} nNpc=Player[nP].m_nIndex; } if(nCamp>0) Npc[nNpc].SetCurrentCamp(nCamp); else Npc[nNpc].SetCurrentCamp(Npc[nNpc].m_Camp); /* 0 = tra ve phe goc */ Lua_PushNumber(L,1); return 1; }
int LuaGetTmpCamp(Lua_State* L){ ... Lua_PushNumber(L, Npc[nNpc].m_CurrentCamp == Npc[nNpc].m_Camp ? 0 : Npc[nNpc].m_CurrentCamp); return 1; }

chu_ky: RemoteExecute(szFile, szFun, hParam[, szCallbackFun, nCallbackParam, dwGameSvrID]) -> khong tra gi. 0x08100757 gettop phai > 2; arg1/arg2 tostring (khac NULL va khac rong: 0x081007C0, 0x08100807), arg3 tonumber handle ObjBuffer (am -> thoat 0x081007FB); gettop==3 (0x081008B5) = khong callback; nguoc lai doc them 3 tham so callback. Dong goi: goi tin protocol 0x3D (0x0810091C), gom ten file+1, ten ham+1, noi dung buffer (tra tu cay [0x9780ce4] theo handle), gioi han 0x8000 byte (0x081008E9), gui sang relay.
ngu_nghia: Goi ham szFun(ParamHandle, ResultHandle[, dwGSID]) trong script szFile O TIEN TRINH KIA (GS<->relay). Ben kia push ket qua vao ResultHandle; neu co callback, relay gui nguoc ve va GS goi szCallbackFun(nCallbackParam, ResultHandle) trong script DA GOI (mau lib/remoteexc.lua:23,30). Cay arena dung 6 lan (player.lua:227,236,245,255,319; map.lua:51) - tat ca KHONG callback (nil,0,nil); phan GS (da mat) can callback cho apply_search_opponents va player_enter_map (tra ket qua qua ResultHandle: protocol.lua:10-11, :31-33).
tuong_duong_jx1: KHONG co (du an 1 GS, khong relay). DynamicExecute (ScriptFuns.cpp:2380) goi ham trong state khac bang lua_dostring nhung KHONG tra ket qua va khong co callback. ObjBuffer OB_* (ScriptFuns.cpp:14777-14790) da co, handle la SO nen dung chung duoc giua cac state.
cach_viet: int LuaRemoteExecute(Lua_State* L){ int nTop=Lua_GetTopIndex(L); if(nTop<3||!Lua_IsString(L,1)||!Lua_IsString(L,2)) return 0; char szLow[MAX_PATH]; g_StrCpyLen(szLow,(char*)Lua_ValueToString(L,1),MAX_PATH); g_StrLower(szLow); const char* szFun=Lua_ValueToString(L,2); int hParam=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,3); KLuaScript* pT=(KLuaScript*)g_GetScript(szLow); if(!pT){ g_DebugLog("[ARENA] RemoteExecute: script chua nap %s -> %s", szLow, szFun); return 0; } int hRes = OB_CreateHandle(); /* dung cung ham C ma LuaOB_Create goi */ char szCall[512]; sprintf(szCall,"%s(%d,%d,1)", szFun, hParam, hRes); int nTop2=0; pT->SafeCallBegin(&nTop2); if(lua_dostring(pT->m_LuaState, szCall)!=0) g_DebugLog("[ARENA] RemoteExecute LOI %s -> %s", szLow, szCall); pT->SafeCallEnd(nTop2); if(nTop>=4 && Lua_IsString(L,4)){ const char* szCb=Lua_ValueToString(L,4); if(szCb && szCb[0]){ int nCbParam=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,5); sprintf(szCall,"%s(%d,%d)", szCb, nCbParam, hRes); if(lua_dostring(L, szCall)!=0) g_DebugLog("[ARENA] RemoteExecute callback LOI %s", szCall); } } OB_ReleaseHandle(hRes); return 0; }  Dang ky {"RemoteExecute", LuaRemoteExecute}.
bay: 1) Linux la BAT DONG BO (qua mang) - ban JX1 dong bo + de quy: relay SearchOpponents -> NotifyEnterMap -> RemoteExecute GS player_enter_map -> NewWorld (KNpc::ChangeWorld ngay lap tuc, ScriptFuns.cpp:3827) -> OnNewWorld -> rule OnEnterMap -> DynamicExecute on_player_enter_map -> RemoteExecute relay player_enter_map TRONG KHI relay dang lap 'for szName,pPlayerInfo in self.tbMap' (player.lua:271). => Phan GS player_enter_map PHAI xep hang (queue) va thuc hien NewWorld o tick sau (AddTimer 1 frame). 2) Goi callback bang lua_dostring(L) tren state dang goi: L dang o giua 1 ham Lua - Lua 4 cho phep goi long (reentrant), nhung KHONG duoc SetTopIndex thap hon top hien tai. 3) map.lua:51 truyen hParam = 0 -> handler GS phai chap nhan handle 0. 4) Chuoi ten ham co the la 'tbX:Fn' -> dostring xu ly duoc.

Ca cay Linux goi voi (tpl,0,0) tru maze (0,1) va dungeonmanager (1,1) - y nghia nP2/nP3 CHUA RO (kha nang: so ban sao nap truoc / co tu huy). rule.lua:317 PreApplyDungeonMap(975,0,0) chay trong AutoFunctions:Run() (autoexec.lua:209) luc boot.
tuong_duong_jx1: KHONG co khai niem ban sao map dong. Moi id trong WorldSet_GameServer.ini nap 1 KSubWorld tinh; NHIEU id co the tro CUNG du lieu ban do (MapList.ini 209/210/211 = 中原南区\演武场一; 213..220 = cung map loi dai) - do la cach JX1 'nhan ban' map. cach_viet:
Bo 'kho ban sao tinh': struct KDungeonPool { int nTpl; std::vector<int> vIds; std::vector<BYTE> vBusy; }; static std::vector<KDungeonPool> s_Pools;
int LuaPreApplyDungeonMap(Lua_State* L){ if(Lua_GetTopIndex(L)<1) return 0; int nTpl=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1); if(sFindPool(nTpl)) return 0; KDungeonPool p; p.nTpl=nTpl; /* doc settings\dungeonmap.ini [Copies] <tpl>=id1,id2,... ; khong co -> chi {tpl} */ KIniFile ini; g_SetFilePath("\\settings"); char szVal[256]=""; if(ini.Load("dungeonmap.ini")){ char szKey[16]; sprintf(szKey,"%d",nTpl); ini.GetString("Copies",szKey,"",szVal,sizeof(szVal)); } if(!szVal[0]) sprintf(szVal,"%d",nTpl); tach theo ',' -> moi id: neu g_SubWorldSet.SearchWorld(id)>=0 thi push (id, busy=0) else g_DebugLog; s_Pools.push_back(p); return 0; }
bay: 1) Chi nhan id DA NAP trong WorldSet (SearchWorld>=0) - id co trong MapList.ini nhung khong trong WorldSet thi bo qua. 2) Them ban sao (vi du 991) = phai sua CA server lan client settings\MapList.ini (client tra id->thu muc map khi vao) + WorldSet_GameServer.ini - MapList.ini du an da dung DU 1000 id 0..999 (grep -c '^[0-9]*=' = 1000) => muon them phai tai su dung id chua nap (978-983 banghuichengbao, 994...) hoac id >= 1000 (CHUA RO client co nhan id >= 1000 khong). Dot 1: pool = {975}.

cach_viet: int LuaApplyDungeonMap(Lua_State* L){ if(Lua_GetTopIndex(L)!=1){Lua_PushNumber(L,0);return 1;} KDungeonPool* p=sFindPool((int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1)); if(p) for(size_t i=0;i<p->vIds.size();i++) if(!p->vBusy[i]){ p->vBusy[i]=1; Lua_PushNumber(L,p->vIds[i]); return 1; } Lua_PushNumber(L,0); return 1; }
